links.comparator_used: The deployed MUST-Plus model's original uncalibrated probabilities, compared with recalibrated probabilities across race, gender and year
links.outcome: Model calibration (intercept and slope) across patient subgroups
links.effect: Overall baseline calibration intercept was -1.25 (95% CI: -1.28, -1.22) and slope was 1.55 (95% CI: 1.51, 1.59). Recalibration improved calibration across race, gender, and year. No post-recalibration numbers are given in the text.
links.quote: Recalibration is effective at reducing miscalibration across all patient subgroups.

design_hint: model recalibration and subgroup calibration monitoring
